name: Honasa Consumer Limited
summary: Honasa Consumer Limited is a beauty and personal care company in India that sells mainly through digital channels. Its products cover baby care, face, body and hair care, color cosmetics and fragrances, under brands such as Mamaearth, The Derma Co., Aqualogica, Ayuga and Dr. Sheth's. It also runs the BBlunt salon network and the Momspresso content platform. Established in 2016, it is headquartered in Gurugram.
